title: Cancellation property
text: We have a common factor of $$x-1$$ on both sides, but if we cancel it, we will lose the $$x-1=0$$ solution! If you want to start this way, make sure you don't forget to collect the missing solution.

title: Expanding both sides
text: While you can expand, having that common factor will help us factor in the long run. So don't expand yet!

title: Plug in values
text: Plugging in values can find you some solutions, but you won't guarantee that you've found them all!

title: Move all terms to one side
text: If we subtract $$2(x-1)$$ from both sides, we will have all terms on one side, and this allows us to factor and use the zero product property to find all possible solutions.
